## What it does or what changed

Write at least one sentence. The review bot needs it before it can merge.

## Websites it contacts

None, or list each host and what is sent.

## Checklist

- [ ] Only `mods/<name>/` is changed
- [ ] `owner.json` has my numeric GitHub user id
- [ ] The version is higher than the published one (updates only)
- [ ] Up to 5 tags from `tags.json` in `plugin.json`
- [ ] `npm run validate -- <name>` passes

The review bot posts a requirements list on this pull request and merges it automatically once everything is met.
